feature_title: Dashboard Add-Panel Chart Selection Icons (SVG + Dark Mode)

rationale.edition: Every changed path (from changed_files.txt) is under web/src/ — web/src/components/dashboards/addPanel/ChartSelection.vue plus web/src/assets/images/dashboard/charts/*. No path touches enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/, and there are no enterprise-only keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/etc.) in the paths or symbols. This is an open-source frontend change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped: the change is user-facing (the dashboard 'Add Panel' chart-type picker), not docs-only/CI-only/comment-only. No skip marker was present — feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty and no tests-added label or skip comment was passed in context. No Playwright E2E specs were added by the diff, so the auto-skip exception does not apply either.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: ChartSelection.vue is the rendered chart-type selector in the Add-Panel dialog, and the diff swaps every chart icon from PNG to SVG, adds scheme-light/dark:scheme-dark theme classes, and changes the maps icon sizing. A regression could break icon rendering or dark-mode appearance, so a test should open the Add-Panel chart selection and verify the icons render and remain selectable.
rationale.area: Dashboards — the only code change is web/src/components/dashboards/addPanel/ChartSelection.vue, which lives in the dashboards add-panel surface, and its sibling Playwright specs live under the Dashboards area (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard-geoMap.spec.js, etc.).
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core — the add-panel chart selection flow is exercised by the core dashboard specs (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard2.spec.js, dashboardtype.spec.js) rather than the chart-type-specific Dashboards-Charts shard; chart selection is the entry point for creating panels of every type.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — the only changed files are a Vue component and static chart icon assets (PNG/SVG). There are no tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js changes, so existing_tests_in_diff is false and the Architect has no dev-authored E2E specs to enhance.
